items.html: And behold, we have explained two aspects of the coupling of ZON of Atzilut: one is the face-to-face coupling, when they are equal in their stature, and the second is the back-to-back coupling. And of these two couplings, one is for Yetzira and one is for Assiya. But we have found and seen a third coupling for ZON, and it is when she is of short stature, up to the chest of ZA alone, yet they are face to face. And this coupling is intermediate between the two aforementioned couplings. And if so, why was another world not created corresponding to this third coupling?
